claim_under_test: README: a Fast pick 'reads no code, so it costs next to nothing'
method: static byte count / 4 (token estimate) over the instruction files each flow is directed to load, measured at foreman d5b6ef9

optional_add_on.when: the skill's 'skim it if you need field semantics' invitation is taken

init.note: plus roadmap-schema.md on the same invitation

reading: the plain what's-next path loads ~25k tokens of instructions before ranking a single entry; R-003's 68-vs-567 guardrail-word figure measures only text inside the produced prompt, an order of magnitude below this
limitations: bytes/4 is an estimate, not a tokenizer count
measures instruction files only — session context, tool results, and the roadmap itself are on top
says nothing about whether the load pays for itself downstream; that question belongs to the runner harness
